We're hiring a Software Engineer to join a growing team building products that reach hundreds of thousands of people thinking about how to do the most good.

This is an individual contributor role on our Online Team, and will be responsible for prioritizing and implementing impactful technical work at CEA. This position reports to the incoming Head of Digital Product. You will collaborate closely with our Senior Software Engineer, Senior Product Designer, and EA Forum Product Lead, along with other teams at CEA as needed.

We’re aiming to hire a mid-level software engineer, but we would consider hiring at the senior level for the right candidate.




ABOUT CEA

The Centre for Effective Altruism (CEA) stewards the movement of people putting effective altruism principles into practice to solve the world's most pressing problems. We’re working to build a flourishing future by applying evidence, reason, and compassion to challenges like global poverty, animal suffering, and existential risks.

Our work centers on growing and supporting a global community of people who rigorously analyze where they can do the most good – and take action on those insights. Current strategic priorities https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/QkE35oTsasMn37o7R/stewardship-cea-s-2025-26-strategy-to-reach-and-raise-ea-s-1 include increasing understanding of effective altruism and its principles, growing the number of people who are motivated by EA principles to take significant action to address pressing problems, and diversifying funding sources for high-impact work.

We had significant success in 2025, building momentum within CEA. Our headcount grew from 42 to 66 core staff. Participation in our programs (e.g., events, courses, groups) grew by 20-25% year over year. We merged https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/BLvTcMMEQGFYsh6Jw/ea-funds-and-cea-are-merging with EA Funds https://funds.effectivealtruism.org/ and are rapidly scaling up our capacity for grantmaking and associated fundraising: our first Fund staffed with full-time employees (EA Animal Welfare Fund https://funds.effectivealtruism.org/funds/animal-welfare), raised almost as much as the previous three years combined.

In 2026, we’ve maintained ambitious momentum https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/Dy4iGHbAkKAQ4t2Dw/building-sustainable-momentum-progress-report-on-cea-s-2025 while laying the foundations for a step-change in the wider EA ecosystem’s growth trajectory from 2027 onwards.




ABOUT THE ONLINE TEAM

The Online Team is a small, fast-paced tech and content team with the expertise to build and run web products that help support and grow the number of people engaging with and applying EA principles to their careers, research, and donations.

We own and operate the EA Forum https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/, and provide critical design and engineering capacity for other CEA projects such as the EA Newsletter https://www.effectivealtruism.org/ea-newsletter-archives, the EA Opportunities Board https://www.effectivealtruism.org/opportunities, and our courses https://www.effectivealtruism.org/courses. Over the last few years we’ve also redesigned and rebuilt effectivealtruism.org http://effectivealtruism.org, funds.effectivealtruism.org http://funds.effectivealtruism.org, and centreforeffectivealtruism.org http://centreforeffectivealtruism.org.

The EA Forum in particular is one of the EA community building institutions with the widest reach, serving 700K annual visitors. As AI capabilities improve, we’re also exploring how integrating AI into CEA’s online product portfolio and internal tooling can help us have more impact.

Our team currently consists of Ollie Etherington https://github.com/oetherington, Senior Software Engineer, Agnes Stenlund https://www.linkedin.com/in/agnesstenlund/,Senior Product Designer, and Toby Tremlett https://www.linkedin.com/in/toby-tremlett-%F0%9F%94%B9-56a5b117a/, EA Forum Product Lead, and we plan to continue expanding in 2027.




ABOUT THE ROLE

CEA has ambitious goals https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/Dy4iGHbAkKAQ4t2Dw/building-sustainable-momentum-progress-report-on-cea-s-2025 for 2027 and beyond, and we need more software engineering capacity in order to reach those goals.

We’re now looking to hire a full-stack engineer who can help make impactful improvements across all of our products. You’ll be implementing new features and bug fixes for various product managers, as well as proactively looking for ways to improve our online products yourself. You’ll be jointly responsible for DevOps, ensuring that all of our sites are fast and reliable, and you’ll take part in our weekly on-call rotation.

The vast majority of our code is written in TypeScript and is built on Node.js, React, Next.js, Postgres, and Elasticsearch. Our sites are hosted on Render, Vercel, and Cloudflare, and our analytics data is stored and processed in PostHog.

Some potential projects you may work on:

 - We’re deep in the process of migrating https://gitlab.com/eaforum/eaforum the EA Forum codebase over to Next.js – if you join, you can help us establish the next evolution of key EA community infrastructure, which we hope will set stronger foundations for many years to come.

 - We’ve recently hired product managers for the EA Opportunities Board https://www.effectivealtruism.org/opportunities and our courses https://www.effectivealtruism.org/courses who will continue driving these projects forwards – some of the changes they’re planning will require engineering.

 - EA Funds https://funds.effectivealtruism.org/ is now part https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/BLvTcMMEQGFYsh6Jw/ea-funds-and-cea-are-merging of CEA, and has not had dedicated technical capacity in a long time. Their team would be excited to collaborate on how to make their processes more efficient using AI (they already have a long list of ideas!)

 - In 2026, we’ve massively overhauled our analytics and data infrastructure, and we’d be excited for a data-minded engineer to continue pushing this project forward. Having a strong data foundation will be crucial for CEA’s ability to find product-market-impact fit https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/DyncXLQ2ysb9K9dfR/you-need-user-buy-in-to-scale-your-impact to scale up our products.

 - CEA is expecting to lean into virtual products in 2027, including running at least one major virtual event.
   
   


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Provide engineering support for multiple CEA teams

 - Implement features and fix issues in our current products to support the work of others on the team.

 - Proactively collaborate with other CEA teams to understand where you can provide value and fill technical gaps, such as by building internal tooling.

 - Ship reliable, maintainable production code, and address high-priority bugs when they come up. AI tools can make us faster, but our work still needs to hold up over time.

 - Ensure that we’re collecting relevant metrics and analytics data, and that it can be used by non-technical members of staff to inform decision-making.

 - Share our weekly on-call rotation with our Senior Software Engineer, Ollie, triaging incoming requests and responding to urgent issues.


IMPROVE ENGINEERING INFRASTRUCTURE

 - Help maintain and improve infrastructure, monitoring, deployments, and testing.

 - Identify high-priority DX problems and develop solutions to help the team work more efficiently.

 - Make justified and cost-effective decisions about what technologies and services we use to build our products.
   
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We're hiring this role at either the Software Engineer or Senior Software Engineer level. The core expectations below apply to both, with additional expectations for the senior level noted at the end.

Core expectations for both levels:

 - Solid full-stack engineering experience. You can independently build and maintain a product like an online forum (frontend, backend, databases, devops, and 3rd-party integrations). You explain your technical decisions clearly enough that teammates can push back. As a baseline, we expect you to be familiar with TypeScript, React, and Postgres, and that you can pick up our other technologies quickly. You write appropriate tests for new functionality.

 - Impact focus. You care about real outcomes and not just shipped features. You gather data, evaluate your work, and iterate quickly. You're excited to explore new opportunities to use software to increase CEA’s impact.

 - Autonomy. You're comfortable being one of two engineers in the organization, and can learn new skills as needed. You’re happy to own the technical-side of a project, working with non-technical product managers to implement ideas end-to-end, including proactively asking for support when necessary.

 - AI fluency. You’ve used AI coding agents and have developed good judgment about where they help, where they fail, and how to verify their output. You can use them to speed up your work, but never at the expense of code architecture or maintainability.


YOUR CANDIDACY WILL BE STRONGER THE MORE YOU ALSO BRING:

 - Devops. You have experience provisioning servers and databases for sites serving hundreds of thousands of active users. You can mitigate adversarial bot attacks, and set sensible, safe caching rules.

 - Prioritization. You back-chain from organizational strategy to prioritize work on different products, and can work with product owners to provide realistic and achievable timelines for implementing changes and new features.

 - Product thinking. You notice particularly good or bad user experiences and reflect on what makes them so, and you can combine these intuitions with targeted analytics data in order to tangibly improve products.

To be considered for the Senior level of this role, we require a candidate to meet the following criteria:

 - Architectural ownership. You have a track record of independently owning the technical direction of a significant project (such as a major refactor or a new product), being clear about the tradeoffs you made and how you will address key risks.

 - A track record of impact. You have a history of shipping production work that mattered to real users, and can point to specific cases where your work moved real outcomes.

 - Strategic autonomy. You can take technical ambiguity and turn it into a credible plan, including translating broad goals into quarterly OKRs and contributing to technical direction at the team level.

We can imagine being excited about candidates with a wide range of different skills and experience, and encourage you to apply even if you aren't sure that you're fully qualified.




OTHER INFORMATION

 - This is a full-time, remote position. We prefer applicants who are able to work in time zones between US Eastern Time and CET.
   
   - We have an office in Oxford, UK, that you would have access to.

 - Start date: January 2027 or sooner

 - Reports to: Incoming Head of Digital Product (Joris Pijpers, Chief of Staff, Community Growth in the interim)

 - Compensation
   
   - Software Engineer
     
     - US: For this role we offer a base salary of $134,900 and a 10% unconditional 401k contribution.
   
   - Senior Software Engineer
     
     - US: For the role we offer a base salary of $166,725 and a 10% unconditional 401k contribution.
   
   - For candidates outside the US, base salary is converted from USD to your local currency using a fixed exchange rate
   
   - Benefits include private health insurance, flexible work hours, a $6,000 annual professional development allowance, a $6,000 mental health support allowance, extended parental leave, ergonomic equipment, 25 days of paid vacation or country-specific time off entitlements, whichever is greater.

 - This role will involve travel. There are likely 2-4 trips annually to attend team retreats and other events, including international trips.

We are committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and encourage individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences to apply. We especially encourage applications from self-identified women and people of colour who are excited about contributing to our mission. The Centre for Effective Altruism is an equal opportunity employer. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, or have any other questions about applying, please contact jobs@centreforeffectivealtruism.org or inform the recruiter directly.

CEA participates in E-Verify for US employees.

We are committed to protecting your data. See our privacy policy https://www.centreforeffectivealtruism.org/privacy for more information.




EVALUATION PLAN

We expect the interview process to include the following steps, subject to minor changes:

 - Application

 - Screening interview

 - Engineering interview

 - Pair programming task

 - Final interviews (2-3)

 - Reference checks

The Opportunity
We’re seeking motivated new graduates and early-career Physician Associate/Assistants (PAs) and Family Nurse Practitioners (FNPs) who are eager to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact. As part of our supportive, collaborative team, you’ll provide exceptional care while playing a key role in improving the health and well-being of our patients. If you’re passionate about delivering high-quality care and building a strong foundation for your future, this opportunity is made for you.
Your Impact
Provide Patient-Centered Care: Conduct health assessments, physical exams, and review medical histories to address short- and long-term patient needs while staying committed to high-quality, efficient patient care.
Assess patient health:  Interview patients, perform physical examinations, obtain, update, and study medical histories.
Determine abnormal conditions:  Administer or order diagnostic tests (e.g., x-rays, electrocardiograms, laboratory studies) and interpret test results.
Perform therapeutic procedures: Administer injections and immunizations, suture, manage wounds and infections.
Educate and Counsel: Empower patients with knowledge about their health, describe therapeutic regimens, give information on normal growth and development, discuss family planning, and wellness through counseling and guidance.
Documentation and Compliance:
Prepare clear, complete, accurate, and legible medical records for each patient under your care. Type, edit, and electronically sign all office notes, reports and records using EMR in accordance with company policies.
Maintain a safe and clean working environment in compliance with company and state procedures, rules, and regulations.
Protect patients and employees by adhering to infection-control policies and protocols.
Comply with legal and professional requirements including studying existing and new legislation, anticipating future legislation, enforcing adherence to requirements, advising management on needed actions.
Collaborate with a Team: Work collaboratively and pro-actively with other providers and health care practitioners within your clinic to efficiently treat patients, and plan coordinated, efficient, and thoughtful dispositions (including transfer), all in a timely manner.
Continuing Education:  Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies.
Who You Are
Education, Licensure, & Certifications:
Master's degree and certification by Physician Assistant (PA) or Nurse Practitioner (NP) certifying body.
Must have and maintain a DEA license with no restrictions.
Basic Life Support (BLS) certification: American Heart Association or American Red Cross BLS certification. We do not accept CPR, ACLS certifications, or online only classes.
Relevant experience: Clinical experience gained through rotations or other settings in emergency medicine, urgent care, or ambulatory care is preferred.
Excellent team player : Enjoy collaborating with others and being a part of a strong team dynamic.
Proactive and confident communicator (written and verbal): Foreshadows and elevates concerns as they arise, unafraid of professional directness both with colleagues and patients.
Compassionate, authentic, and patient focused: Supports patients through kindness; demonstrating understanding for others and contributing to the creating a community of belonging.
Technically savvy: Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software and clinical management systems (EMR).
Strong knowledge of:
Principles and processes for providing customer and personal services, including customer needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction.
Applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations including the requirements of the HIPAA and OSHA and applicable state rules and regulations pertinent to medical practices.
Relevant drugs and their chemical composition, structure, and properties of substances and of the chemical processes and transformations that they undergo.
Non-pharmaceutical patient care aids, their applicable uses, and relevance to patient care.
Current principles, methods, and procedures for the delivery of medical evaluation, diagnosis, and treatment.
